name: Graph run lifecycle world
target: Exercise pause, cancel, and descendant-commit fork through the production graph run ledger after an active node owner disappears.
inputs: blocked active node with simulated lost owner
pause, cancel, or descendant commit fork operation
observations: pause preserves completed receipts and resumes the interrupted node once
cancel remains terminal and refuses resume
fork creates an independent run with source lineage and target commit while retaining the source ledger
